query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM queue.tasks t
               JOIN analysis.observables o ON o.root_id = t.root_id AND o.id = t.observable_id
               WHERE t.root_id = $1
                 AND t.state IN ('queued', 'delayed', 'running')
                 AND o.depth < $2
                 AND t.module <> ALL($3)
           ) AS "pending!"
